title: Largest sum of a contiguous subarray
summary: A hiker logs every climb and drop; keep the running total of the current stretch, and start fresh the moment it sinks below zero.
goal: Find the stretch of consecutive legs with the biggest total climb

mapping.story: Best stretch ending at this leg

examples.label: Mostly climbing
examples.explanation: The whole hike: the small drop is worth crossing.

ladder.name: Add up every stretch
ladder.idea: For each start, extend to the right keeping a running total, and keep the best total seen.

ladder.name: Best stretch ending here
ladder.idea: For each leg, the best stretch ending here either continues the best stretch ending at the previous leg or starts fresh. Keep the best of these.
ladder.insight: A stretch with a negative total only drags down whatever follows it, so starting fresh beats continuing it. That makes the best stretch ending at each leg a one-step decision.

transfer.problem: A shop's daily profits and losses are listed. Find the most profitable run of consecutive days.
transfer.explanation: The best run ending today either extends yesterday's best run or starts today; keep the best overall.

selfCheck: Starts fresh when continuing would be worse than the leg alone.
Keeps the best total over all legs.
Handles all-negative input by returning the largest single leg.
